title: Controlled repository portability remediation
goal: Remediate confirmed repository portability and developer-independence defects without making unapproved architectural decisions.
constraints: Do not modify database schema or migrations.
Do not modify authentication or authorization behavior.
Do not change the AI agent architecture.
Do not remove the Gemini agent restriction yet.
Do not arbitrarily change development ports.
Do not delete historical audit artifacts.
Do not delete historical evidence from docs/archive.
Do not expose or print secret values.
acceptance_criteria: Developer-machine-specific absolute filesystem paths are removed from active repository documentation and agent infrastructure.
No file:/// local filesystem links remain in active repository documentation or generated control-plane artifacts.
The JESTER Agent Skill explicitly prohibits generating developer-machine-specific paths or local filesystem URLs.
Repository-relative references are used for internal repository documentation.
Personal developer identity and real personal data are not required by the repository's development workflow.
A root .gitattributes file is added with an appropriate cross-platform line-ending policy.
The broken README LICENSE reference is either corrected to an existing repository file or explicitly documented as requiring a separate decision.
Environment setup requirements are documented without embedding machine-specific paths.
All remediation changes remain within the approved scope.
A structured remediation report is produced under .jester/reports/implementations/.
The task ends in review and is not marked completed.
verification: Search the active repository for absolute developer-machine paths.
Verify internal Markdown references are repository-relative or otherwise portable.
Inspect AGENTS.md and SKILL.md for the new portability invariant.
Verify personal developer data is no longer required for normal development.
Run relevant tests after code/fixture changes.
Run frontend build if frontend-related files are changed.
Confirm no prohibited files were modified.
